results.description:
The night I finally escaped my father's world, a man with burning gold eyes ran me off the road.

He's the president of the Black Tide Butchers. Scarred. Ruthless. All leather, fury, and a debt my father refuses to pay.

I'm supposed to be his leverage. Nothing more.

So why does he look at me like I'm the only thing in this swamp worth saving?

He locked me in an old sugar mill above black water. I tested every wall. I ran. And every time, he found me and carried me back like I already belonged to him.

Now the powerful men I trusted are hunting us both.

And the outlaw who stole me is the only one willing to bleed to keep me breathing.

He says I'm his. The terrifying part? I'm starting to believe him.

What happens when the man holding the key to your cage is the only one who's ever set you free?

Steamy fated mates. Senator's daughter. Possessive alpha wolf biker. Captive romance. Enemies to lovers. Guaranteed HEA.
